faults: Reduce the number of internal shapes to six or fewer; the current design uses seven distinct shapes (base, shadow, three trees, and two negative-space gaps), which violates the 'Draw six shapes or fewer' rule.

Increase the lightness difference between the tree fill and the base fill; the current dark green is too close in lightness to the base, violating the rule that shapes must differ in lightness, not hue alone.
Ensure the negative space between the trees is at least 3 units wide; the gaps between the central and side trees are too narrow and merge into a single dark mass at the display size.
verdict: The candidate reads as a forest at the display size, but it uses too many shapes and relies on a hue-only color difference that fails the style guide's contrast rule.
